# the paths that run .github/workflows/security-audit.yml (scripts/changed_paths.py decide)
# on.pull_request.paths of the workflow, when it has one, must list the same patterns in
# the same order (scripts/changed_paths.py sync)
# every file a job of the workflow executes or reads is listed: a missing one skips the
# job on a change that alters it
Cargo.toml
Cargo.lock
src/**
deny.toml
# cargo audit and cargo deny also check the separate scripts/cfg-items workspace
# through its own lock (its Cargo.toml is covered by **/Cargo.toml below)
scripts/cfg-items/Cargo.lock
# every cargo job runs at the repository root, where this file picks the toolchain
rust-toolchain.toml
# cargo-machete reads every manifest under the root (fuzz/Cargo.toml and
# scripts/cfg-items/Cargo.toml have their own) and every .rs file under it as a use of a
# dependency (tests/, benches/, examples/, fuzz/); the coverage job compiles
# tests/lib/bvh_oracles.rs and tests/law_id_world.rs into the lib tests (#[path])
**/Cargo.toml
**/*.rs
# cargo package lists the files it packages through git (.gitignore filters them) and
# needs the manifest's `readme`
.gitignore
README.md
# public-api-diff compares with the committed snapshot
docs/PUBLIC_API_SNAPSHOT.txt
# semver-checks reads its log with semver_checked.py, which imports ansi.py
scripts/semver_checked.py
# and decides which packages have a baseline with semver_baseline_has.py
scripts/semver_baseline_has.py
scripts/test_semver_baseline_has.py
scripts/ansi.py
# the coverage job: the ratchet and its baseline
scripts/line_coverage_ratchet.py
scripts/line-coverage-baseline.txt
# package-integrity: the shipped-file check and the licence files it requires; the other
# shipped documents (CHANGELOG.md, README_JP.md, ...) are packed as they are and their
# content cannot change what the job checks or builds
scripts/package_contents_check.py
scripts/test_package_contents_check.py
LICENSE-AGPL
LICENSE-COMMERCIAL.md
# the changes and gate jobs
scripts/changed_paths.py
.github/workflows/security-audit.yml
.github/paths/security-audit.txt
